before: The text surface matched undo and redo keys in its own keydown handler. The picture overlay did not forward them, and the context menu stayed open during a clipboard read.
after: The text surface and the picture overlay share one key matcher, and both call the existing local undo and redo. The context menu closes before the clipboard read starts.
reason: Only local key routing and menu timing change. Undo and redo use the existing per-participant history, and paste uses the existing paste command. Shared nodes, operations, and serialization remain unchanged.
